notes.title: SeedHero – Patch Notes v0.9.2
notes.content:
🛠️ New Sound Settings Screen on First Launch
We've added a sound configuration menu that appears before the tutorial when you launch the game for the first time. This was based on player feedback saying the tutorial music was too loud — now you can adjust the volume before jumping in.

🐛 Bug Fix: Sound Settings Not Applied on Startup
Fixed an issue where sound settings weren’t properly applied when starting the game. Previously, the volume would only update after opening the settings menu. Now it loads your preferences right away.
